headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to enforce and carry out the abortion-related limits written into the Affordable Care Act.
what_it_does: This order tells the federal government how to handle the abortion restrictions that are part of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, the 2010 health care law. Based on its title, it directs agencies to enforce those restrictions and put them into practice as the law is rolled out. The title alone does not spell out the specific steps agencies must take.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to enforce and carry out the abortion restrictions in the health care law as they implement it.

who_it_affects.group: People who get health coverage through programs created by the Affordable Care Act
who_it_affects.how: The coverage they get is subject to the law's abortion restrictions, which this order directs agencies to enforce.

who_it_affects.group: Health insurers and health care providers taking part in Affordable Care Act programs
who_it_affects.how: They may have to follow rules agencies set to carry out the law's abortion restrictions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 24, 2010. Executive orders generally take effect when signed.
